title: H.A.C.D. Action Log Entry
description: One append-only record of an action H.A.C.D. performed. Every scenario export carries one, so a study can be audited after the fact: what ran, against which campus and run, and what it caught.

project.description: The campus the action ran against.

model.description: The scenario branch and run id, e.g. 'baseline · run 8f430a36'. Identical inputs always produce an identical run id, so two entries with the same model string evaluated the same Scenario.

action.description: An action from the allowlist. Nothing outside it may be logged.

result.description: Whether the action itself completed. A study that finds problems is still a success; the problems go in issues.

issues.description: Every check the run flagged. Omitted entirely when nothing was flagged.

issue_type.description: The id of the check that flagged it, e.g. 'power' or 'water'.

severity.description: A breached check logs as high, an at-risk check as medium.

would_have_reached_client.description: True when the problem would have gone into the client-facing study had this run not flagged it.

duration_before_hours.description: Hours the same work took without H.A.C.D., in quarter hours. Recorded by a person in the pilot tracker — the app never fills this in, because it cannot know it.

duration_after_hours.description: Hours the work took with H.A.C.D. Always recorded together with duration_before_hours, and never larger than it.
